hypothesis: The first inference that can influence BalanceActive_Standing still receives an approximately 30 degree live-root versus PoseSearch-target-root mismatch, placing the first target-relative position and rotation slice outside the checkpoint's learned input distribution.
competing_explanations: The preparation snapshot may not represent the first policy-active inference; the root mismatch could disappear by BalanceActive_Standing.
Observation/action handedness or Manny constraint-axis decoding may remain incorrect even if root-frame semantics are corrected.
expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The first active-standing snapshot retains a large root-relative rotation and multi-sigma first-slice position and rotation outliers.
falsification_observation: The first active-standing target-relative root is near identity and its first-slice channels are within the learned distribution while RealOnnxPolicy still fails.

conclusion.summary: The approximately 31 degree root mismatch and severe first-slice distribution outliers persist into the first policy-active inference. The competing explanation that the mismatch was preparation-only is falsified. This does not yet prove that root anchoring will improve standing, and it does not rule out an additional action or constraint-axis error.

next_highest_information_experiment.single_variable: Under an explicit development-only harness override, capture the PoseSearch data-to-live root transform at the first active-standing inference and freeze that transform for the run.
next_highest_information_experiment.required_ab: Rerun the unchanged RealOnnxPolicy baseline beside the root-aligned variant using the same commit, seed, timestep, pose, no-perturbation standing-plant window, and evaluator.
next_highest_information_experiment.primary_semantic_metric: First active-standing target-relative root rotation and normalized first-slice position/rotation outliers.
next_highest_information_experiment.promotion_rule: Do not promote. If the A/B supports the hypothesis, remove the experimental override or leave it test-only, then promote the behavior in a separate commit and rerun the locked ladder.
